content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(CDR-014 In-Cluster TTP Chain Behavioral Causality) AND ABIOC(CDR-014 Anomalous Multi-Stage Container Discovery and Exfil) GROUPED BY container_id, causality_id, causality_actor_process_image_name WITHIN 900s — fuses the two auto-tuned behavioral deviations into one in-cluster behavioral-anomaly incident anchored to the single containerd-shim -> shell process_lineage causality chain (same container_id + causality_id), not two disconnected anomalies.
rules.name: Multi-Stage In-Cluster TTP Chain — ABIOC Causality Stitch
